title: Vietnamese-Style Ham and Cheese Quesadilla
description: A fusion take on a classic quesadilla, featuring crispy Vietnamese pho ham and gooey cheese.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Butter one side of each tortilla.
Place one tortilla, buttered side down, in the skillet.
Top with Vietnamese Pho Ham, Mozzarella Cheese, and Cheddar Cheese.
Place the second tortilla, buttered side up, on top.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is crispy.
Cut into wedges and serve immediately.
